description: Look up Eco chat (slash) commands on this server, from the game's own command registry. Pass a command name ("give", "unstuck", "manage playtime"), words from what it does ("weather", "stuck"), or a full line the player typed ("/give birch seed 100"). Returns each match's exact usage line (arguments are COMMA-separated; [bracketed] ones optional, with defaults), its shortcut, and who can use it (Everyone / Moderator / Admin). For a typed line it also returns `interpretation`: how the game would read it, argument by argument, any problems, and a `corrected` line when the arguments were separated by spaces instead of commas.

query.description: A command name, a typed command line, or words describing what the command does.

name: wiki_commands
